name: Merge
spec: yellow diamond with a black vertical arrow and a second line joining it from the right
meaning: Traffic is merging from the right; adjust speed and position.

snippets.back: The manual requires moving over to give emergency vehicles on the shoulder additional protection.
The emergency or parking brake must be able to hold the vehicle still on a grade.
Suggested emergency equipment includes jumper cables, a flashlight, flares, washer fluid, winter wipers, snow tires or chains, a scraper and a snow brush.
The recommended emergency kit includes first-aid supplies, extra clothing, boots, a blanket, sand, a shovel and food.
Move a person exposed to carbon monoxide into fresh air, according to the handbook's emergency advice.
Do not cut into the stopping space a truck leaves ahead, because a sudden brake application can create a dangerous emergency.
Except in an emergency, parking is prohibited on freeway pavement, shoulders and other parts of its right-of-way.
A lane-narrowing instruction may direct traffic to merge left.

evidence: [sec08-card-sec08-F024 | AK p.40] A lane-narrowing instruction may direct traffic to merge left.
result.summary: No snippet describes the yellow-diamond spec and no snippet states merging from the right; the only merge snippet mentions merge left.
